name: influencer.bio_set
description: Records one read of a person's Instagram bio: the bio Business Discovery gave (an empty one is kept as empty; null when it could not be read: the bio kept stays). Answers what the model would now tag from (source). Internal.
sql:
update brandbase.influencers i set
  bio = coalesce(btrim(:bio::text), i.bio),
  bio_read_at = :now::timestamptz
where i.id = :id::uuid
returning jsonb_build_object('id', i.id, 'source', brandbase.influencer_tag_source(i.category, i.notes, i.bio)) as result
